Note to the reviewr: this limit is imposed by `tvb_memcpy`. A shorter value would work as well, but I didn't find any suitable value.

According to https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/SSH_keys the maximum is 2048 bytes (16384 bits). I'd be tempted to set it to something smaller (e.g. 512 bytes / 4096 bits) and only increase it if someone complains.
